personas.name: Maria Hernandez
personas.summary: Maria, 34, undocumented DoorDash driver, Los Angeles. Primary financial tool: CashApp. ITIN pending since 2023. Income: $800-1,200/week, paid daily, highly irregular. Device: shared Android, 2 SIM cards. Family: sends $200-400/month to mother in Oaxaca via Remitly. Peak earning: Friday/Saturday nights. Loss tolerance: cannot absorb any fraud loss above $150.

personas.name: Tuan Nguyen
personas.summary: Tuan, 52, nail salon co-owner in Houston, sends to elderly parents in Da Nang. Uses Western Union in-person at a Vietnamese-owned shop on Bellaire Blvd. Trusts only one cashier. Cash deposits in $1,500-2,000 chunks twice monthly. Frequent target of 'family in trouble' phone scams in Vietnamese.

personas.name: Adaeze Okafor
personas.summary: Adaeze, 29, registered nurse in Newark NJ, sends to siblings in Lagos. Uses Sendwave for speed. Works night shifts; transactions cluster 2am-5am ET. Recently targeted by Yoruba-language WhatsApp scam impersonating cousin asking for school fees.

personas.name: Jean-Baptiste Pierre
personas.summary: Jean-Baptiste, 41, construction laborer in Brooklyn, sends to wife and three children in Port-au-Prince. Uses CAM Transfer and occasionally hand-carries cash via traveling friend ('boat' / informal courier). Speaks Haitian Creole. Was robbed of $600 cash in 2023 and now distrusts couriers.

personas.name: Ravi Patel
personas.summary: Ravi, 38, software contractor in Sunnyvale on H-1B, sends to parents in Ahmedabad. Uses Wise for FX rate optimization. Sophisticated; monitors INR/USD daily. Targets of 'Microsoft tech support' scams in Hindi-English.

personas.name: Esperanza Reyes
personas.summary: Esperanza, 47, hotel housekeeper in Las Vegas, sends to son in El Salvador. Uses Walmart-to-Walmart transfers, pays in cash. Has been a victim of estafa twice in three years (fake ICE call demanding payment, romance scam). Limited English.

personas.name: Linh Tran
personas.summary: Linh, 26, dental hygienist in San Jose, sends to grandmother in Ho Chi Minh City. Uses Zelle to her aunt in California who relays cash via VND in Vietnam. Hybrid digital/informal corridor. Tech-savvy.

personas.name: Boluwatife Adeyemi
personas.summary: Boluwatife, 35, Uber driver in Atlanta, sends to extended family in Ibadan. Uses Sendwave and crypto (USDT on Binance) for larger sums. Members of his Yoruba diaspora WhatsApp group share scam alerts. Has lost $400 to fake church donation scam.

personas.name: Carlos Mendoza
personas.summary: Carlos, 58, retired factory worker in Chicago, sends pension to widowed sister in Guadalajara. Fixed income $1,800/month Social Security. Uses MoneyGram in-store, distrusts apps. Highly vulnerable to phone-based estafa.

personas.name: Priya Krishnan
personas.summary: Priya, 31, ESL teacher in Queens, Tamil Nadu native. Sends quarterly to parents and monthly to grandmother. Uses Remitly and ICICI Money2India. Maintains spreadsheet of FX history. Targets of UPI-impersonation scams in Tamil.

personas.name: Ana Lucia Diaz
personas.summary: Ana Lucia, 24, college student in Miami, works two part-time jobs. Sends to mother in Havana via informal mulas (couriers traveling Miami-Havana). Limited formal corridor options. Cash-based, highly informal economy. Vulnerable to courier theft and confiscation.

personas.name: DeShawn Williams
personas.summary: DeShawn, 28, Uber + DoorDash + Instacart driver in Atlanta. Cashes out daily via Uber Instant Pay + DoorDash Fast Pay ($1.99 fee each). Lives paycheck to paycheck, balance never above $200. Has been ATO'd once via SIM swap, lost $340.

personas.name: Yuki Tanaka
personas.summary: Yuki, 35, full-time Lyft driver in San Francisco, also TaskRabbit. Stable iPhone, single SIM 5+ years. Cashes out weekly to credit union. Lost $1,200 to fake-support phishing impersonating Lyft.
personas.device_stability: iPhone, 5+ years same device family, single SIM stable

personas.name: Rajesh Sharma
personas.summary: Rajesh, 32, Amazon Flex + Uber Eats in suburban NJ. Drives 5am-9am Flex blocks then evening Uber Eats. Uses prepaid Visa from his bank to receive payouts. Has had OTP fraud attempts via Hindi-language calls claiming to be from Amazon.
personas.daily_cashout_pattern: Flex weekly, Uber daily after dinner rush

personas.name: Ahmed Bah
personas.summary: Ahmed, 41, NYC yellow cab + Uber. Speaks Wolof + French + English. Account hacked Dec 2024 via fake email; lost three days of earnings ($840). Now uses Yubikey and locked-down 2FA.

personas.name: Brittany Cole
personas.summary: Brittany, 24, Instacart + Shipt + occasional OnlyFans. Multi-platform high churn. Switches phones often (3 in 18 months). Multiple Cash App tags. High device instability flag for fraud models.
personas.daily_cashout_pattern: irregular, multiple times daily across platforms

personas.name: Hai Pham
personas.summary: Hai, 39, full-time DoorDash in Houston. Vietnamese community ties. Has heard of 'fake support' calls from his Facebook group; cautious. Uses business debit card, separate from personal. Cashes out every Friday.

personas.name: Olumide Bakare
personas.summary: Olumide, 30, Uber + Lyft + Bolt(when visiting Lagos). US-based. Targeted by Yoruba-language WhatsApp scam selling 'fake background check expedite'. Lost $200.

personas.name: Maria Soto
personas.summary: Maria, 45, single mother, Postmates + Rover dog walking. Spanish-speaking, Phoenix AZ. Uses Chime account. Was victim of stolen-card chargeback fraud where customer disputed legitimate delivery.

personas.name: Tyler Brennan
personas.summary: Tyler, 22, Uber Eats bike courier in Brooklyn. Lives with roommates, no car. iPhone hand-me-down from older sister. Account once frozen for 'suspicious activity' (false positive); now hyper-aware.

personas.name: Devi Reddy
personas.summary: Devi, 36, Telugu-speaking, gig CPA + TaskRabbit assembly + Rover. Highly skilled, multi-income. iPad Pro for CPA work, separate phone for gigs. Targets of OTP-stealing scams via WhatsApp.
personas.daily_cashout_pattern: CPA via direct deposit, gigs cashed daily

personas.name: Marcus Johnson
personas.summary: Marcus, 27, full-time DoorDash + Spark (Walmart). Detroit. Account ATO'd via credential stuffing using leaked password from 2019 breach. Now uses password manager.
personas.daily_cashout_pattern: fast pay $1.99 every dash, multiple times daily

personas.name: Roosevelt Banks
personas.summary: Roosevelt, 54, day laborer in Memphis. ChexSystems-flagged from 2011 overdraft, cannot open bank account. Uses Walmart MoneyCard prepaid + corner-store check cashing (3% fee). Cashes payroll Friday at same kiosk for 8 years. Targets of advance-fee loan scams via SMS.
personas.kiosk_location: Memphis corner liquor store + Walmart MoneyCenter

personas.name: Lupe Vasquez
personas.summary: Lupe, 38, undocumented housekeeper in Phoenix. Cash-only income. Uses Vanilla Visa gift cards to pay bills online. Stack of 4-6 active prepaid cards. Lost $200 to fake utility shutoff scam in Spanish.
personas.kiosk_location: Phoenix dollar store + check cashing on Van Buren

personas.name: Thi Le
personas.summary: Thi, 61, retired garment worker in Oakland. Pays bills in cash at the Vietnamese-owned market that runs an informal hawala-style remittance and bill-pay desk. Speaks no English. Has been overcharged repeatedly but trusts no one outside the community.
personas.kiosk_location: Vietnamese grocery in Oakland, in-community informal hawala

personas.name: Jamal Ahmed
personas.summary: Jamal, 33, Somali immigrant in Minneapolis. Uses hawala for remittances to Mogadishu and a credit union for daily banking. Targets of fake IRS phone scams in Somali, has resisted them.
personas.kiosk_location: Cedar-Riverside hawala desk + community credit union

personas.name: Crystal Davis
personas.summary: Crystal, 26, hair braider in New Orleans, working booth-rental at salon. Cash income. Uses 4 prepaid cards strategically (one for rent, one for car, one for food, one for fun). Lost $400 to predatory payday loan rollover trap.

personas.name: Felipe Gonzalez
personas.summary: Felipe, 49, day laborer at Home Depot parking lot in Houston. Cash, no documents, no bank. Uses Western Union to send to Honduras. Has been short-changed at kiosk repeatedly. Lost $300 in fake job-listing advance fee.
personas.kiosk_location: Houston Home Depot lot + WU at La Michoacana

personas.name: Aisha Toure
personas.summary: Aisha, 31, Senegalese braider in the Bronx. Mix of cash and Cash App. Uses Wolof and French. Targeted by fake immigration-attorney advance-fee fraud, lost $600.

personas.name: Robert Kowalski
personas.summary: Robert, 67, retired union ironworker in Cleveland. Pension + SS. Distrusts banks since 2008. Cashes pension check at kiosk, keeps cash at home. Frequent target of grandparent scam (fake grandchild in jail).

personas.name: Yolanda Marquez
personas.summary: Yolanda, 42, food truck cook in San Antonio. Cash and Zelle. Two prepaid cards rotated. Mexican-American, second-generation. Family member fell for kiosk skimmer; she now inspects every kiosk.
personas.income_source: food truck daily cash + Zelle tips

personas.name: Jose Ramirez
personas.summary: Jose, 44, ITIN-holder operating a landscaping LLC in Dallas. Files Schedule C since 2018. Uses a bilingual CPA in Oak Cliff. Credit file age 6 years (built via secured cards). Was victim of synthetic-identity fraud: someone used a similar SSN-like number to open credit in a variant of his name.
personas.accountant_relationship: bilingual CPA in Oak Cliff Dallas, 5+ years

personas.name: Mei Chen
personas.summary: Mei, 39, ITIN-holder owns a nail salon in Queens NY. Files 1120-S for S-corp. Mandarin-speaking CPA. Strong credit file (8 years). Targets of EIN/business-identity theft attempts on her LLC.

personas.name: Ahmed Hassan
personas.summary: Ahmed, 36, ITIN-holder, Egyptian, runs a halal food truck in Detroit. Files Schedule C. New to US tax system (3 filings). Uses VITA volunteer tax prep. Thin credit file. Targeted by tax-refund advance-loan scam.

personas.name: Sandra Morales
personas.summary: Sandra, 51, Salvadoran ITIN-holder, owns 2-unit rental property in Houston. Files Schedule E. Uses small-firm CPA. Solid credit (12 years). Was victim of identity theft: fraudulent EIN created in her business name.

personas.name: Thanh Nguyen
personas.summary: Thanh, 33, ITIN-holder, Vietnamese, runs auto-detailing shop in San Jose. Filed first return 2023. Uses bilingual CPA in San Jose Vietnamese business district. Thin credit, just got first secured card. Vulnerable to synthetic-identity fraud.
personas.accountant_relationship: Vietnamese CPA in San Jose, 1 year

personas.name: Roberto Sanchez
personas.summary: Roberto, 47, ITIN-holder, Mexican, owns construction subcontracting LLC in Phoenix. Files 1065 partnership return with brother. CPA who specializes in Mexican-American small businesses. Established credit. Targets of IRS impersonation calls in Spanish.

personas.name: Priyanka Iyer
personas.summary: Priyanka, 35, ITIN-holder on dependent visa, runs Etsy jewelry business from home. Files Schedule C. Tamil-speaking. Uses TurboTax + paid review by CPA. Strong digital footprint, thin formal credit.

personas.name: Carlos Bermudez
personas.summary: Carlos, 56, ITIN-holder, Cuban, owns small bodega in Miami. Files Schedule C since 1998 (long-tenured ITIN). Spanish-only CPA in Hialeah. 20+ year credit file built carefully. Stable but a frequent target of refund-scam phone calls.

personas.name: Linda Park
personas.summary: Linda, 41, ITIN-holder, Korean, runs dry cleaner in LA. Files 1120-S. Korean-speaking CPA in Koreatown. Was victim of synthetic-identity fraud where attacker combined her name with fabricated SSN to open credit lines in 2024.
